sources.title: Diffusion at Scale: Introducing Mercury 3
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the October 19, 2026 public launch. Its scaling section explicitly describes more than 40 times Mercury 1 Mini total parameters, but supplies no absolute baseline or count; the chart uses a relative parameter axis. TinyFish and other customer results concern task performance, not model size. No named unchanged base architecture or active count is stated.

sources.title: Models - Inception Platform
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the exact Mercury 3 row and current model comparison table. They document text format, 1M context, 131,072 maximum output tokens, tools and structured outputs, but contain no total or activated-parameter column, backbone count, or sized named-base relationship.

sources.title: Reasoning Efforts
sources.evidence: Names mercury-3 and documents instant, low, medium and high reasoning effort, with low as its default.

sources.title: Tool Use
sources.evidence: Explicitly documents Mercury 3 function calling, including parallel calls with JSON arguments and application-executed tools.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.evidence: Explicitly states Mercury 3 accepts text input only and does not support image generation. Mercury Decide is separately identified as accepting images.

sources.title: Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Inception retains ownership of its services, grants limited nontransferable use rights, and restricts copying, modification, redistribution and reverse engineering. Supports proprietary service licensing rather than an open weight license.

sources.title: Research - Inception
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the research archive and its Mercury technical report. The archive lists the June 17, 2025 Mercury paper and earlier research; no Mercury 3 technical report or model card with total or active counts is present.

sources.title: Mercury: Ultra-Fast Language Models Based on Diffusion
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the original June 2025 Mercury report, including its Mini/Small model descriptions, architecture, evaluations and scaling discussion. It describes a Transformer but provides no absolute count for Mercury Coder Mini or Small. Consequently it cannot turn the Mercury 3 relative scaling claim into an absolute count, establish Mercury 3 active parameters, or prove an unchanged sized-base relationship.

sources.title: Models.dev Mercury 3 source record
sources.evidence: Upstream comments explicitly derive October 16 from OpenRouter first-listing metadata while identifying October 19 as the public launch post. Used only to trace the baseline date conflict.

sources.title: OpenRouter model catalog: inception/mercury-3
sources.evidence: Exact record has created=1792158337 (October 16, 2026 UTC) and canonical_slug=inception/mercury-3-20261019. Catalog creation alone does not establish public release on October 16.

sources.title: Streaming & Diffusion
sources.evidence: Names Mercury 3 and documents block-by-block text streaming and intermediate iterative denoising steps.

sources.title: Inception official dated blog index
sources.evidence: The exact Diffusion at Scale: Introducing Mercury 3 link is dated October 19, 2026; its linked announcement says available today. This is primary public-launch date evidence, separate from OpenRouter catalog creation.

sources.title: Inception co-founder response on Mercury 3 model size
sources.evidence: October 19, 2026 reply by volodia in the Mercury 3 launch discussion explicitly states that the team is not publicly announcing model size. The same account identifies itself as Volodymyr, Inception co-founder and chief scientist, in the launch comment s14. This is direct developer confirmation of nondisclosure, not an inferred parameter estimate.

sources.title: Mercury 3 launch discussion by Inception co-founder
sources.evidence: The opening comment identifies its author as Volodymyr, Inception co-founder and chief scientist, and repeats the greater-than-40x total-parameter scaling claim. Replies say weights are not being released and technical posts/reports may follow. No absolute total, activated count or sized unchanged base is supplied.

sources.title: Why Inception's Mercury 3 upends the AI status quo
sources.evidence: Original October 19 interview/report quotes Inception CEO Stefano Ermon and states that the team is not providing a total count, despite the 40x scaling comparison. Used to corroborate nondisclosure; the journalist’s subsequent speculation about likely size is not a developer specification and is not adopted.

sources.title: Mercury 3 model library
sources.evidence: Freshly inspected the serving partner’s exact Mercury 3 page. It gives only the more-than-40x Mercury 1 size comparison, 1M context and generation speed. It supplies no absolute total, active count or unchanged sized-base relationship.

name.note: Exact developer product name and API identifier mercury-3.

developer.note: Published by the Inception team as its own model.

release_date.note: Official index dates the announcement October 19; the linked launch says available that day. October 16 is provider catalog creation, not established public release; earlier partner access is undated.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is a proprietary hosted service; inspected release and model documentation offer no downloadable weights or open weight license.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the service terms, not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: The fresh primary-source search confirms nondisclosure: Inception’s co-founder explicitly declined to announce model size in the launch discussion. The developer gives only a greater-than-40x total-size ratio to Mercury 1 Mini; the original Mini/Small report provides no absolute baseline. Neither nominal total nor an unchanged relationship to a sized base is established. Do not turn an assumed 7B baseline into a greater-than-280B specification.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh searches for Mercury 3 active/activated parameters and newer original comparison reports found no exactly identified numerical active-count convention. The current developer table, launch, research archive, original Mercury paper and serving-partner page supply none. The published greater-than-40x claim is explicitly about total parameters; it does not establish active parameters, dense/MoE structure, or a count inherited from a named base.

architecture.note: Text diffusion with iterative denoising is explicit. Mercury 3 backbone and dense versus MoE structure remain undisclosed; the Coder report does not establish them.

context_window.note: Developer reports 1M tokens; retained as nominal decimal 1,000,000, not an independently specified unrounded limit. Maximum output is a separate 131,072 tokens.

modalities.note: Text-only input and text chat completion output. Voice applications do not establish native audio support.

reasoning.note: Dedicated reasoning-effort controls explicitly apply to mercury-3.

tool_call.note: Provider documents function calling and parallel tool calls for this exact model.

description.value: Inception's diffusion reasoning model for chat, multi-step problem solving, and tool use
description.note: Plain capability description is supported; it makes no benchmark or speed claim.

patch.notes: Public launch was October 19, 2026; October 16 is OpenRouter catalog creation. Inception reports more than 40 times Mercury 1 Mini’s total parameters but has not disclosed an absolute total or active count. Its co-founder explicitly confirmed model-size nondisclosure. Diffusion is confirmed; the backbone and dense/MoE structure remain undisclosed. The 1M context is the developer’s nominal specification.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts. Reopened the launch, current comparison table, research archive and original Mercury paper; checked the developer launch discussion, original CEO interview and serving-partner page. Found direct co-founder confirmation that model size is not public. The greater-than-40x total ratio lacks an absolute Mini baseline, and no newer original active-count table or sized-base relationship was found. All non-parameter assessments are preserved.
